decision: held: neither trial has open full text and the abstracts do not name a primary outcome: 11788381 is a 10-man crossover (2 g L-carnitine/day as LCLT for 3 weeks) on biochemical and MRI muscle-disruption markers; 20045157 is an 18-person crossover in middle-aged adults with Carnipure tartrate (2 g/day L-carnitine). Small crossover biomarker studies with unverifiable primary endpoints cannot be completed to the credit standard. Dr. Pham's active-amount correction (2 g L-carnitine, not 2 g tartrate) is retained in the summary. OA retry 2026-10-28: no open copy of 11788381 or 20045157.
summary: 11788381: LCLT attenuated exercise-induced purine-catabolism markers, myoglobin, FABP, CK and MDA and reduced MRI-assessed muscle disruption. 20045157: Carnipure tartrate improved biochemical recovery markers after resistance exercise in middle-aged men and women. Both are surrogate recovery markers from very small samples.
